# Synthetic test fixtures

Every response, evidence string, identifier, and credential-like value in these
tests is authored synthetic data. No fixture was captured from a phone call,
CALL-E dashboard, transcript, or raw live provider response. Phone-shaped values
exist only to test rejection, masking, and guarded contracts with network sends
blocked; they are not contact examples and must never be dialed. These values do
not claim to be allocated or reserved test numbers.

The English reference task is tested offline only. Passing contract tests does
not demonstrate provider execution or English conversation quality.
